title: BumpReport
description: Report shape produced by the built-in deterministic `bump` Action (Step 9.6.3, Decision #125). Deterministic actions do NOT extend `report-base.schema.json` — that base carries `confidence` + `safety` which are LLM-specific. Carried as a top-level schema so future deterministic actions can reuse the same minimal envelope. The bump Action returns one of three report shapes, distinguished by `ok` / `noop` / `reason`: success-with-write (`{ ok: true, version }`), silent-no-op (`{ ok: true, noop: true }`), or refusal (`{ ok: false, reason: 'fresh' }`).

ok.description: True when the Action accepted the request (either it materialised a write or it was a silent no-op under `force`). False when the Action refused the request (e.g. fresh node without `force`).

noop.description: True when the Action accepted the request but did not produce a write (the node was already fresh and `force: true` opted into the silent no-op path). Mutually exclusive with `version`.

reason.description: Refusal reason, present only when `ok: false`. `fresh` = the node has no drift versus its sidecar and the caller did not pass `force: true`.

version.description: The new `annotations.version` value the Action wrote. Present only when `ok: true` and `noop` is absent.

createdSidecar.description: True when this bump created the `.sm` file (no sidecar existed on disk before). Triggers the `audit.createdAt` / `audit.createdBy` fill-in.
